title: The Empty Cot
narration: The baby monitor started crying three months before my baby was born. Although I unplugged it, the screen showed our empty nursery one year in the future. Future me silently told me to check the attic. There I found old baby clothes, hospital records and a death certificate for an infant son bearing my name. My husband called from downstairs and said I was never supposed to remember him. The silence felt deliberate, as though someone nearby was waiting for me to understand the trap before moving again. For several seconds I could hear nothing except my breathing and the small ordinary sounds around me. Every explanation I tried made the details worse, because each clue had been placed where I alone would find it. Then the attic door locked, and the unplugged monitor began playing a lullaby beside me.
